user.title: Connect Panasonic H&C Bluetooth
user.description: Select your Panasonic controller from nearby Bluetooth devices, or enter its MAC address. Renamed devices may appear under their custom name. Pair it with your adapter or ESPHome proxy first; this screen checks the connection and does not create a Bluetooth bond.

init.title: Connect Panasonic H&C Bluetooth
init.description: Connect to controller {mac}. Complete Bluetooth pairing first.

error.invalid_mac_address: Enter six hexadecimal pairs separated by colons (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the controller. Check Bluetooth range, pairing and active proxy connections, then retry.
error.unknown: An unexpected Bluetooth error occurred. See the integration logs and retry.

invalid_setting.message: The requested controller setting is invalid.

command_failed.message: Unable to complete the controller command: {reason}.

reconnect_failed.message: The controller could not reconnect. Check proxy availability and pairing; Home Assistant will retry setup.

entry_disabled.message: Enable this integration entry before reconnecting.

reconnect.name: Reconnect Bluetooth
reconnect.description: Reload the selected controller connection and let Home Assistant select an available Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Does not change pairing or HVAC settings.
